diagnosticsDescription: Save a ZIP with application and core versions, basic settings and recent warnings and errors. Subscription files and access keys are excluded; known credentials, hosts, IPs and file paths are masked in logs. Nothing is sent automatically.
diagnosticsFailed: Could not save diagnostics. Check the selected folder and available disk space.
backupDescription: Export saved settings, profiles, rules, themes and localizations. Backups contain subscription URLs and access keys. Save or discard pending changes first. Restoring replaces settings and profiles and restarts the application.
backupFailed: Could not complete the backup operation. Check the file and available disk space.
shortcutConflict: This shortcut is already assigned to “{action}”.
shortcutRecordFailed: Could not start recording. Please try again.
shortcutRecordingHint: Press Ctrl, Alt or Win with a key, or an F1–F24 key. Release to assign. Esc cancels.
shortcutSaveHint: Click a button to record a combination, then save settings to activate it globally. Use the trash button to remove an assignment.
updateUnsupported: Auto-update is available in the installed Windows version only.
applicationsThatHonorWindowsProxySetting: Applications that honor Windows proxy settings will use this endpoint. TUN can capture traffic from other applications.
automaticallyStartMihomoWhenQzyriumOpens: Automatically start Mihomo when Qzyrium opens.
captureDeviceTrafficWithAVirtualNetworkI: Capture device traffic with a virtual network interface.
capturesTrafficFromApplicationsThatDoNot: Captures traffic from applications that do not use the system proxy.
changesCouldNotBeAppliedCheckTheErrorAbo: Changes could not be applied. Check the error above.
chooseHowTheVirtualInterfaceHandlesPacke: Choose how the virtual interface handles packets. gVisor (user-space, recommended), System (kernel stack), Mixed (system TCP + gVisor UDP).
connectionModesDescription: Primary routing switches for directing network traffic through Qzyrium.
configureTheLocalProxyAndDestinationsTha: Configure the local proxy and destinations that bypass it.
controlsTheVerbosityOfTheCoreLogStream: Controls the verbosity of the core log stream.
createRoutesForTheVirtualInterface: Create routes for the virtual interface.
followYourSystemThemeOrChooseOneExplicit: Follow your system theme or choose one explicitly.
keepTheApplicationRunningWhenTheWindowIs: Keep the application running when the window is closed.
languageHint: Choose the language used across the application.
letOtherDevicesConnectToTheLocalProxy: Let other devices connect to the local proxy.
manageListeningPortsAndCoreBehavior: Manage listening ports and core behavior.
mixedAndControllerPortsMustBeDifferent: Mixed and controller ports must be different.
networkSectionDescription: Configure system proxy, TUN interface, DNS, sniffer, and geodata resources.
oneEntryPerLineForExampleAny53: One entry per line, for example any:53.
oneHostOrWildcardPerLineLocalDestination: One host or wildcard per line. Local destinations are excluded by default.
overrideProfileHint: Apply these values to all subscriptions. Unspecified fields keep the subscription value.
subscriptionSettingsHint: Settings are taken from the subscription. Enable the override to customize them.
pacScriptHint: Leave empty for the built-in script. Variables: {{host}}, {{port}}.
restrictTrafficThatCouldBypassTheVirtual: Restrict traffic that could bypass the virtual interface.
savingCoreSettingsRestartsMihomoExisting: Saving core settings restarts Mihomo. Existing sessions will reconnect.
silentStartDescription: Start the application minimized to the system tray.
systemProxySubtitle: Windows system proxy endpoint for browsers and compatible tools.
tUNModeSubtitle: Global capture for all applications via virtual network adapter driver.
customLocalizationHint: Download a JSON example with all current translation keys. Set its name, locale and baseLanguage (en or ru), then edit the messages, keeping placeholders such as {count}. Upload the file, select it in the language list and save settings. Missing keys use the base language. Uploading the same id replaces that localization.
invalidLocalizationFile: Invalid localization file. Check the metadata, messages, plural forms and placeholders against the example.
localizationFileError: Could not open or save the localization file.
invalidThemeFile: That file doesn't look like a valid theme — it needs a "mode" and/or "colors" field.
sysProxyDisabledDueToTun: Unavailable: TUN mode is currently enabled. Only one capture mode can be active at a time.
tunDisabledDueToSysProxy: Unavailable: System proxy is currently enabled. Only one capture mode can be active at a time.
tunRequiresAdmin: TUN mode requires Administrator privileges. Please restart as Administrator.
tunAdminExplanation: TUN mode requires Administrator privileges to create and configure the virtual network adapter in Windows.
startupDescription: Automatic startup, connection and system tray behavior.
performanceDescription: Graphics, data refresh rate and log retention.
subscriptionsDescription: Automatic subscription updates and download requests.
shortcutsDescription: Global shortcuts for controlling the application.
coreOnlyDescription: Close the interface to free memory. The core keeps its current state; control it and restore the interface from the tray. Save pending settings first.
connectionDescription: Traffic display and connection behavior when switching nodes.
latencyDescription: Test URL, timeout and number of concurrent checks.
updatesDescription: Automatic checks for new application versions.
closeActionDescription: Choose whether to keep the interface in the tray, quit, or keep only the core running. The tray menu can reopen the interface.
logStorageDescription: Configure disk recording and archive limits independently for each log type. Disabling disk recording keeps the live journal available.
